a: The Rocket Fund is the athletic department's official annual giving program. Gifts provide essential support for more than 400 student-athletes across 17 varsity sports — funding scholarships, academic assistance, and equipment needs.

q: How do I make my gift?
a: Three ways: give online, call the Rocket Fund at 419.530.2510 (text or call), or mail a check to the Athletic Development Office, The University of Toledo, 2801 West Bancroft Street MS 302, Toledo, OH 43606.

q: How is a Rocket Fund gift different from my ticket or seat payment?
a: Philanthropic gifts to the Rocket Fund are above and beyond any required payments for seating and parking. Your gift is an investment in student-athletes, and it also determines your donor benefits and priority level.

q: At what giving level do benefits begin?
a: Benefits are provided at the $100 level and up, across six membership levels: Century ($100), Blue ($300), Gold ($600), Executive ($1,200), Coaches ($2,500), and Directors ($5,000 and up). Privileges increase with your level of support.

q: What is the deadline to give for football and basketball benefits?
a: To receive parking and seating benefits for the coming season, give by June 30 for football and by August 1 for basketball.

q: Can I direct my gift to a specific sport or area?
a: Yes. Gifts may be designated Unrestricted (for the needs the Athletic Department judges most important), to Scholarship Aid for all student-athletes, or to Program Operations for a particular team. Any Rocket Fund gift connected to premium seat payments or benefits must be designated Unrestricted.

q: What is the Joe Grogan Room?
a: The Joe Grogan Room is the donor hospitality room at Savage Arena. It is open to all Rocket Fund donors at the Gold level ($600 and above) during men's and women's basketball games, and pregame table reservations are available to Executive-level donors ($1,200 and above). A game ticket is also required for entry.

q: With my donation, do I receive premium parking?
a: All payments to the Rocket Fund include a season parking pass if requested, with areas assigned by membership level.
Football: Century — Areas 3 and 4 · Blue — Area 5 · Gold and Executive — Area 10 · Coaches and Directors — Area 9.

Basketball: Century and Blue receive an Area B pass (Area 10 for men's games; Areas 3, 5 and 6 for women's games, excluding doubleheaders). Gold, Executive, Coaches and Directors receive an Area A pass (Lots 3, 4, 5, 6 and 18).

GameChange is a giving platform that rounds up everyday purchases on an enrolled credit or debit card to the next dollar and directs the change to Toledo Athletics — an automatic, effortless way to support Rocket student-athletes all year long.

q: Can I make a gift that lasts beyond a single season?
a: Yes. The Rocket Fund Legacy Society lets you endow your support in perpetuity. The athletic department may use 4% of the endowment annually for its top priorities, and investment gains above that are reinvested so the endowment lasts forever.

q: How do I update my information or reach the Rocket Fund team?
a: The office is open 9 a.m. – 5 p.m., Monday through Friday. Call or text 419.530.2510, or email rocketsathleticdevelopment@utoledo.edu. Our full staff directory is on the Our Team page.
